info.title: DMI Open Data API - Climate observation
info.description:
Free access to the Danish Meteorological Institutes data.

The services are open and require no authentication, but please respect our Terms of use when using the API.

Information about the Climate Data service

This service follows the standard for OGC API Features as described in OGC API - Features - Part 1: Core

parameters.name: stationId
parameters.description: Filter by stationId

parameters.name: datetime
parameters.description:
datetime searching as specified in https://docs.opengeospatial.org/is/17-069r3/17-069r3.html#_parameter_datetime and dates as specified in RFC3339 https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc3339. Will filter to only include station values which starts within the specified time interval. Both the upper and lower limit is inclusive.
As an illustrative example, if you asked for the interval 2004-03-12T14:00:00Z - 2004-04-14:15:00:00Z you would get:
  • All hour station values in the range
  • All day values from 2004-03-13 until and including 2004-04-14. Day values for 2004-03-12 is excluded because 14:00:00Z is after the start of the day for any parameter/station combination.
  • The month values for 2004-04, because they starts sometime around 2004-04-01 depending on parameter and timezone the station is located in

Station values from February 12, 2018, 0.description: Returns station values on a closed time interval.
Returns station values after a given start time, range inclusive.
